children: Overview
China diversified-industries investor's interim revenue grew 29% yr/yr to RMB 362.9 bln
Net profit contributions to equity holders rose 219% yr/yr to RMB 2.23 bln
Company increased R&D expenses 18% yr/yr to RMB 10 bln for technology innovation
Outlook
Company did not provide specific financial outlook
Result Drivers
LENOVO GROWTH - Revenue from Lenovo rose 30% yr/yr, making up the bulk of the group's revenue increase
TECHNOLOGY INVESTMENT - R&D expenses increased 18% yr/yr to RMB 10 bln, supporting innovation initiatives
INDUSTRIAL INVESTMENTS TURNAROUND - Net profit contributions from industrial incubations and investments swung to RMB 2.44 bln from a loss of RMB 386 mln

Analyst Coverage
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "strong buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the computer hardware peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Legend Holdings Corp is HK$22.60, about 21.3% above its August 27 closing price of HK$18.63
The stock recently traded at 7 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 9 three months ago
